name: Conditional sibling inference framework and tail-architecture tests
model_likelihood: Standardised S2|S1=s1 ~ Normal(s1*h2/2, 1-h2^2/4), analytically marginalised over mid-parent genetic trait; infinitesimal additive null.
prior: Latent mid-parent population distribution mg ~ Normal(0,h2/2); population model, not a SNP-effect shrinkage prior; no effect penalty specified.
inference_algorithm: Conditional-likelihood maximisation over h2 using body-indexed sibling pairs; one-sided mean-shift score test for excess discordance and one-sided concordance score test for inherited rare architecture.
estimand: Polygenic heritability and tail-specific departures from polygenic sibling expectation consistent with de novo or inherited rare-variant enrichment.
data_input: Sibling relationships and paired standardised trait values; genetic data are not required.
tunable_settings: Index-body range used for heritability (5th-95th percentiles in paper); tested lower and upper tail quantiles (e.g. 1%); choice of tail and one-sided alternative.
